protocol.gate_rules: Audit the proposed changes to this step's prospective action set, using only the visible conversation. The first set is the no-new-read decision; the second is the proposed decision after the tool reply. Review exactly the listed additions and removals. For each addition, require a concrete current trigger for the specific action, object and latest instruction. A related event or a nearby time is insufficient. The return may mix prior and new entries; do not treat every returned entry as a fresh event. Use the latest visible instruction and the exact time when an action requires one. Accept a removal only when the action lacks a current basis, was superseded, or conflicts with a better-supported action. Keep an independently supported action when another action becomes due. Do not assume the previously selected actions were all correct.
protocol.short_format: Return only {"add":[],"remove":[]}, with accepted handles in the corresponding array. An omitted handle is a rejection. Do not include reasons, request a tool, or propose other actions.
protocol.index_rules: The visible_evidence_index lists verbatim day instructions and up to two recent narrative mentions per changed action. A later explicit update supersedes an older instruction for the same action. Align that current trigger to the object, attribute and time in the latest actual tool reply or visible narrative. A related object or different attribute is not evidence for this action. A missing quotation only means the index has no exact lexical match; consult the full conversation. Do not invent an event time or freshness for a returned item. Treat unsupported details as unknown. Preserve an independently supported action when the reply does not invalidate it.
